  "cons": [
    "Lacks advanced features like Gantt charts or time tracking.",
    "No built-in option for setting task reminders.",
    "Limited customization compared to other tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As an Admin Virtual Assistant, this person found Basecamp to be a straightforward and easy-to-use tool for managing projects, especially for a self-employed individual in the E-Learning industry. It provided the core functionalities needed for task organization and client management. However, the absence of advanced features like Gantt charts, time tracking, and task reminders was a noticeable limitation, preventing a higher overall satisfaction despite its ease of use."
